deadline.value: No central deadline: each professor recruits their own doctoral students; some posts are advertised as vacancies
deadline.quote: Each potential doctoral thesis supervisor recruits their doctoral students themselves.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

supervisor.value: A professor must agree to supervise you; contact professorships directly (the Doctoral Administration does not match candidates)
supervisor.quote: In order to be able to complete a doctorate at ETH, a professor at ETH must be willing to supervise your dissertation.

funding.value: With few exceptions doctorates are linked to a position (employment) at ETH or in the ETH Domain
funding.quote: With few exceptions, doctorates are linked to a position at ETH or within the ETH-domain.

entry_route.value: Normally a Master's degree is required; exceptional Bachelor's graduates can apply for the Direct Doctorate in Physics (Master's + doctorate) in the 1-30 November 2026 window, with a future ETH supervisor's funding confirmation.
entry_route.quote: You must have a university Master's degree.

also.quote: Direct Doctorate (applications in the first application window only) | For a successful application, a confirmation of the future supervisor (ETH professor) is required.
The Department of Physics hosts four institutes: Particle Physics and Astrophysics, Quantum Electronics, Solid State Physics and Theoretical Physics.

notes: Individual doctorate model: no overarching doctoral school. See the AVETH survival guide linked from the page. Astrophysics is covered by D-PHYS (Institute for Particle Physics and Astrophysics).
